In lowland rice growing, what does 'transplanting' mean?

A. Broadcasting dry seed onto flooded soil
B. Moving young rice seedlings from a nursery into the main field
C. Harvesting the rice by hand
D. Draining all the water from the field

Answer with the single correct option.
B. Moving young rice seedlings from a nursery into the main field

Why is well-decomposed (rotted) manure preferred over fresh manure at planting?

A. Fresh manure can scorch crops and tie up nitrogen
B. Rotted manure has no nutrients
C. Fresh manure raises pH too much
D. Rotted manure kills all soil life

Answer with the single correct option.
A. Fresh manure can scorch crops and tie up nitrogen

Planting common beans at the recommended spacing rather than throwing seed thickly helps because:

A. Well-spaced plants get better light and air and compete less
B. Thick crowding always increases pod yield
C. Spacing makes no difference to beans
D. Crowded beans need less weeding

Answer with the single correct option.
A. Well-spaced plants get better light and air and compete less

Besides spreading disease, a heavy tick infestation on cattle can directly cause what?

A. Louder mooing
B. Anaemia and weight loss from blood feeding
C. Faster milk production
D. Stronger hooves

Answer with the single correct option.
B. Anaemia and weight loss from blood feeding

When is nitrogen top-dressing typically applied to maize?

A. At planting only
B. After harvest
C. When the crop is knee-high, about 4-6 weeks after emergence
D. Never; maize needs no nitrogen

Answer with the single correct option.
C. When the crop is knee-high, about 4-6 weeks after emergence

Which cultural practice helps reduce fall armyworm pressure across a community?

A. Early, uniform planting within the area
B. Late and staggered planting
C. Continuous maize monocropping
D. Clearing all natural vegetation around fields

Answer with the single correct option.
A. Early, uniform planting within the area

Apart from sucking sap, why are whiteflies especially dangerous to crops?

A. They pollinate weeds
B. They transmit plant viruses
C. They eat the roots
D. They improve soil fertility

Answer with the single correct option.
B. They transmit plant viruses
Can I use animal manure instead of buying fertilizer, and how much?

Yes, well-rotted manure improves the soil and feeds crops. Compost it first for 2 to 3 months so it does not burn roots or spread weed seeds. Apply two to four handfuls per planting hole, or spread and mix it into the soil before planting. Manure alone is often low in nutrients, so combine it with a smaller amount of mineral fertilizer for the best yields.
How can I water my vegetables using less water in the dry season?

Water in the early morning or evening so less is lost to the sun, and put it at the plant roots, not the leaves. Low-cost drip lines or a bucket-and-hose drip kit save the most. Mulch the soil with dry grass or leaves to hold moisture and block weeds. Make shallow basins around each plant so water soaks in instead of running off.

Ni njia gani nzuri ya bei nafuu ya kudhibiti viwavijeshi mapema kwa mkulima mdogo?

A. Kumwagilia maji mengi kila siku
B. Kukagua shamba mara kwa mara na kuua viwavi kwa mkono au kuweka mchanga au majivu kwenye kilele cha mmea
C. Kupanda mahindi kwa wingi zaidi ili kuwazidi wadudu
D. Kuongeza mbolea ya urea maradufu

Answer with the single correct option.
B. Kukagua shamba mara kwa mara na kuua viwavi kwa mkono au kuweka mchanga au majivu kwenye kilele cha mmea

Which practice helps manage Striga in cereal fields?

A. Intercropping or rotating with legumes and improving soil fertility
B. Continuous cereal monocropping
C. Reducing all soil organic matter
D. Planting only in heavily infested fields

Answer with the single correct option.
A. Intercropping or rotating with legumes and improving soil fertility
How does intercropping help me reduce risk on my small farm?

Growing two crops together spreads your risk: if one fails from drought or pests, the other may still yield. A legume like beans or cowpeas grown with maize also adds nitrogen to the soil, covers the ground to hold moisture, and gives you food and cash from the same plot. Match a tall crop with a short one, and don't crowd them so both get light.

Menene fa'idar amfani da takin gargajiya (compost) a gona?

A. Yana kara gishiri a cikin kasa
B. Yana inganta kasa, kara sinadarai, da taimakawa kasa rike ruwa
C. Yana kashe dukkan tsirrai
D. Ba shi da wani amfani ga kasa

Answer with the single correct option.
B. Yana inganta kasa, kara sinadarai, da taimakawa kasa rike ruwa
When and how should I transplant my rice seedlings?

Transplant rice seedlings when they are about 3 to 4 weeks old and 15 to 20 cm tall, into a well-puddled, levelled field with shallow standing water. Plant two to three seedlings per hill, spacing hills about 20 cm apart in rows. Transplanting young seedlings in rows gives stronger tillering and easier weeding than broadcasting. Keep the field moist and weed early for a better yield.

Ni ugonjwa gani wa ng'ombe huenezwa na kupe?

A. Ugonjwa wa mdondo (Newcastle)
B. Ndigana (East Coast fever)
C. Batobato wa mihogo
D. Kichaa cha mbwa

Answer with the single correct option.
B. Ndigana (East Coast fever)

Leaving crop residues on the field after harvest mainly helps to?

A. Protect the soil and add organic matter
B. Increase soil erosion
C. Remove soil nutrients
D. Lower the water table

Answer with the single correct option.
A. Protect the soil and add organic matter

Which nutrient is most important for strong root development and early seedling establishment?

A. Potassium (K)
B. Nitrogen (N)
C. Magnesium (Mg)
D. Phosphorus (P)

Answer with the single correct option.
D. Phosphorus (P)
How can I harvest and store rainwater for my crops and animals?

Catch roof runoff from your house into a tank or lined drum through a gutter. In the field, dig shallow trenches along the contour, planting pits (zai pits), or half-moon bunds to trap runoff where crops grow. A small lined pond or earth dam can store water for animals and dry-spell irrigation. Cover stored water and keep it clean to reduce loss and mosquitoes.

Ta yaya jakunkunan PICS ke kare hatsi daga kwari a lokacin ajiya?

A. Ta zuba magani mai guba a cikin hatsi
B. Ta wanke hatsi da ruwa kafin ajiya
C. Ta hanyar dumama hatsi da wuta
D. Ta hana iska (oxygen) shiga jakar, wanda ke kashe kwari ba tare da sinadarai ba

Answer with the single correct option.
D. Ta hana iska (oxygen) shiga jakar, wanda ke kashe kwari ba tare da sinadarai ba

When is weed control most important for getting a good maize yield?

A. Only after the maize has tasseled
B. During the first few weeks after the maize emerges
C. Only at harvest time
D. Weeds never affect maize yield

Answer with the single correct option.
B. During the first few weeks after the maize emerges

Menene ke haifar da aflatoxin a masara da gyada?

A. Yawan ruwan sama a lokacin girbi kadai
B. Naman gwari (fungus) da ke girma a hatsin da ba a bushe da kyau ba ko aka ajiye da danshi
C. Amfani da taki mai yawa
D. Shuka amfanin gona da wuri

Answer with the single correct option.
B. Naman gwari (fungus) da ke girma a hatsin da ba a bushe da kyau ba ko aka ajiye da danshi
Nizuie vipi ugonjwa wa mdondo (Newcastle) kwa kuku wangu?

Ugonjwa wa mdondo huenea kwa haraka na kuua kuku wengi. Kinga bora ni chanjo: chanja vifaranga wakiwa na umri wa wiki moja, na urudie kila baada ya miezi mitatu. Tenga kuku wagonjwa mara moja, safisha banda, na usichanganye kuku wapya na wa zamani bila kuwatenga kwanza. Chanjo hupatikana katika kliniki za mifugo.

Mifuko ya PICS (mifuko ya tabaka tatu) husaidiaje kuhifadhi nafaka?

A. Huongeza unyevu ndani ya nafaka
B. Hufanya nafaka kuota haraka
C. Huvutia panya na wadudu
D. Huzuia hewa na kuua wadudu bila kutumia dawa

Answer with the single correct option.
D. Huzuia hewa na kuua wadudu bila kutumia dawa

Sorting out and discarding mouldy or insect-damaged grains before storage mainly helps to do what?

A. Increase the total weight stored
B. Make the grain germinate faster
C. Reduce aflatoxin and stop pests spreading in the store
D. Raise the moisture content safely

Answer with the single correct option.
C. Reduce aflatoxin and stop pests spreading in the store
Me ya sa zan jujjuya masara da wake ko gyada a gona?

Wake da gyada suna qara sinadarin nitrogen a qasa ta hanyar qwayoyin da ke saiwoyinsu, wanda ke wadata qasa domin masara a shekara mai zuwa. Wannan jujjuyawa kuma na yanke zagayowar kwari da cututtukan da ke kai wa masara hari, tare da rage kashe kudi kan taki na sinadarai.
